primary_source.text: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: Whenever signals exhibiting the words “Walk,” “Don’t Walk,” “Wait” or similar symbols are in place, such signals indicate as follows: While the “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated, is flashing and is accompanied by a countdown timer, a pedestrian may proceed across the highway in the direction of the signal, but must complete the crossing before the countdown timer gets to zero.

referenced_source_packets.text: Except as provided in NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B]: Between adjacent intersections at which official traffic-control devices are in operation pedestrians shall not cross at any place except in a marked crosswalk.
referenced_source_packets.observation_needed: Record whether crossing is between adjacent device-controlled intersections and whether the crossing is marked.

referenced_source_packets.text: Except as provided in NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B]: A pedestrian shall not cross an intersection diagonally unless authorized by official traffic-control devices.
referenced_source_packets.observation_needed: Record whether the pedestrian crosses an intersection diagonally and any official authorization.

referenced_source_packets.text: Except as provided in NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B]: When authorized to cross diagonally, pedestrians shall cross only in accordance with the official traffic-control devices pertaining to such crossing movements.
referenced_source_packets.observation_needed: If diagonal crossing is authorized, record the governing device and whether the movement follows it.

referenced_source_packets.text: Every pedestrian crossing a roadway at any point other than within a marked crosswalk or within an unmarked crosswalk at an intersection shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles upon the roadway. The foregoing rules in this Section shall have no application under the conditions stated in Section 11.30.070 when pedestrians are prohibited from crossing at certain designated places.
referenced_source_packets.observation_needed: Record crossing location, marked/unmarked crosswalk status, vehicles present, and any designated crossing prohibition.

referenced_source_packets.text: Any pedestrian crossing a roadway at a point where a pedestrian tunnel or overhead pedestrian crossing has been provided shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles upon the roadway. The foregoing rules in this Section shall have no application under the conditions stated in Section 11.30.070 when pedestrians are prohibited from crossing at certain designated places.
referenced_source_packets.observation_needed: Record any pedestrian tunnel or overhead crossing and designated crossing prohibition.

referenced_source_packets.text: Any pedestrian who is not wholly or partially blind, or any driver of any vehicle who approaches or comes in contact with a person wholly or partially blind, carrying a cane or walking stick white in color, or white tipped in red, or being assisted by a person with wisdom, shall immediately come to a full stop and take such precautions before proceeding as may be necessary to avoid an accident or injury to the person wholly or partially blind.
referenced_source_packets.observation_needed: Record any wholly or partially blind pedestrian and cane/assistance context; the frozen source is a separate blind-pedestrian rule.

referenced_source_packets.text: It shall be unlawful for any person driving or operating, propelling or causing to be propelled, any vehicle, to fail to stop not less than fifty feet from the nearest side of a school pedestrian lane where any signal device, flagman or other person is stationed, giving warning that children are about to cross or are crossing the street; and it is further declared unlawful to proceed until such signal has stopped, raised, or been removed, or the flagman or person stationed at such pedestrian lane has given a signal to go, or has left the locality.
